correctness.rationale: Known rational tongue criterion yields L≤b≤U. Order of degree-one lifts gives nondecreasing rotation number in λ; analytic nonconstant plateau edges are therefore strictly decreasing, proving unique inverse roots and the single closed λ interval. The exact floor moment ∑floor(kq/p)=(p−1)(q−1)/2 yields endpoint derivatives and the universal weak-edge aperture. The first missing c_j at ceil(q/(q−p))−1 determines both strong-edge scales; at p=q−1 exact complementary identities give distinct fractional powers. A 1,493-case integer combinatorial checker and 9 high-precision endpoint tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite claim.
